objective: Improve motion rPPG heart-rate accuracy and continuity by preserving fixed local skin-patch time series before spatial aggregation.
population: The same six previously seen development videos; no claim of held-out or subject-independent validation.
reference_policy: All inference and patch selection are reference-free. Reuse the original frozen 309 planned reference windows and estimated alignment, never optimize time offsets or choose a method per video using reference error.
frontend: One configuration: twelve persistent patches (four within each of the original three facial regions), local landmark anchors, observed RGB and paired pixel tracking, local anomaly screening, same-ID fallback and explicit missing/reset provenance. Re-extract local geometry and pixels from original videos.

design.early: Pool the same measured local RGB traces within each of the three parent regions before POS/CHROM; use the same downstream patch representative selection and aggregation rules.
design.late: Preserve each local patch through POS/CHROM; equalize parent-region influence during HR aggregation, so repeated methods, branches and neighboring patches do not create extra parent-region votes.
design.aggregators: Standard hierarchical median versus fixed complete-link clustering of full normalized PSD vectors. The HR median may be between observed spectral peaks and is labeled as an aggregate, never used to generate a waveform.
design.factorial_waveform: All four readout experiments use the identical saved, measured broadband waveform from late_psd_cluster. Existing V25 spectral/periodic/harmonic scoring and gates are fixed; switch only existing motion evidence on/off and local choice versus DP.

output_contract.primary_spatial_HR: Derived from saved patch BVPs, not asserted to be the HR of one averaged waveform.
output_contract.waveform: A traceable mixture of actual contributing broadband patch waveforms; no sine synthesis, reference-driven filtering or HR interpolation. It does not validate PPG morphology.
output_contract.secondary_HR: Save a separate V25 readout of each displayed fused waveform for consistency diagnostics.
output_contract.missing: NaN with explicit rejection/source flags; never zero or held HR.
output_contract.coverage: Keep every original planned window in denominator; distinguish framewise waveform availability, patch availability, accepted HR and correct HR.

preservation: Keep V25 recommended entry, V26 experiments, original videos, references and failed trials. Install a new version only after tests and independent evaluation, with the actual outcome clearly reported.
implementation_claim: Independent implementation inspired by patch preservation and PSD clustering; not a reproduction of the authors' exact benchmark or promised 1.70 bpm result.
